subject: Q3 Compass — owner compact, risk map, and QBR rehearsal timeline
messages:
From: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Anita Shah <anita.shah@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Thu, 10 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Q3 Compass — owner compact, risk map, and QBR rehearsal timeline

Team — kicking off the Q3 OKR sign-off and the QBR prep cadence. I pulled together an owner-compact draft and a short rehearsal plan for the leadership readout. High level: 

- Goal: finalize owner commitments and a focused risk matrix by EOD Tue (May 15).
- Rehearsal: leadership dry run Wed May 22 (30 mins) followed by owners run-through Thu May 23.
- Ask: leaders to review the attached owner_compact and add redlines inline; owners to annotate top-3 risks/catastrophes in column D.

Attachments: Q3_Compass_OKR_owner_compact.xlsx (owner table + measures), QBR_rehearsal_runbook_v1.pdf (timeline + roles).

Key questions for leadership:
1) Are the success metrics for the Serving Runtime and Dedicated product lines too aggressive (see rows 4–9)?
2) Any constraints I should call out in the runbook (compliance checklist, customer demo slot)?

I've looped Anita from Acme — they want to confirm their co-sell metric and will join the owners rehearsal if we keep it to 30 mins.

Next steps (proposed):
- Today: leaders provide redlines on owner_compact.
- Mon May 14: owners submit risk map.
- Tue May 15: exec sign-off (email confirmation).

Thanks — please reply with "ack" or quick notes inline so I can consolidate before EOD.

—Rohan
Rohan Mehta
VP, Product Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Anita Shah <anita.shah@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Thu, 10 May 2028 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q3 Compass — owner compact, risk map, and QBR rehearsal timeline

Rohan — thanks for pulling this together. Quick read and a couple of notes inline: 

- Row 5 (Serving runtime latency SLO): suggest we make the target conditional on 95th pct trimmed by geo — otherwise ops will flag unrealistic expectations.
- Add an explicit fallback owner for the Dedicated capacity SKU (to cover vacation and escalation).
- For the QBR runbook, please add a 5-minute contingency buffer after demos for immediate action items — helps capture immediate blockers.

I can get redlines into the spreadsheet by EOD today. On the rehearsal: Wed May 22 at 10:00 PST works for me.

Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Customer Success | Redwood Inference

Date: Thu, 10 May 2028 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q3 Compass — owner compact, risk map, and QBR rehearsal timeline

Thanks Rohan — good concise plan. A few leadership-level calls: 

- Pace back the absolute throughput targets in Serving runtime (Laura's call). Make them conditional on quantization profile and batch efficiency (we should note the dependency explicitly).
- For Dedicated, add a short SLA exception path for early access customers (we'll need legal sign-off but call it out now).
- Risk treatment: add a mitigation owner column and a 30/60/90 remediation tracker (simple status).

I approve the rehearsal dates. Also, please include a single-slide one-pager for the exec readout that highlights the 3 tradeoffs and asks (cost vs latency vs reliability). Rohan — can your team produce that by Tue morning?

Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Chief Product Officer | Redwood Inference

Appreciate the quick turn. Updates: 

- Incorporated Laura's conditional SLO language and added fallback owners for Dedicated (sheet v1.1).
- Added a mitigation-owner column and a simple 30/60/90 tracker per Vivek's ask.
- One-pager (slide) is in the shared drive link below; owners please pull the deck fragment and keep comments to the slide notes.

Action items for owners:
- Kimberly: finalize metrics for the Dedicated SKU and add vacation/backfill owner. Due: Mon May 14 COB.
- Markus: own the runbook timing for demos and the 5-minute buffer. Due: Mon May 14 COB.
- Laura: confirm customer-facing co-sell metric with Anita and mark whether Acme will present in the QBR. Due: Mon May 14 COB.
- All owners: populate top-3 risks in column D by Mon May 14.

Attachments uploaded: Q3_Compass_OKR_owner_compact.xlsx (v1.1), QBR_rehearsal_runbook_v1.pdf.
